headline: On last trading week, Indian markets extended winning streak to four weeks as Sensex and Nifty hit 9-month highs.

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Monday, 23 November.

why: Sensex and Nifty extended their winning streak to four consecutive weeks with around 3% gains.
Record FII buying drove benchmark indices to 9-month highs during the week.
Banking, IT, and auto stocks supported market recoveries across recent sessions.
Early-session pressure from global AI selloff and Fed rate hike signals was mitigated by domestic buying.
whatHappening: GST Network integrated metro rail as the fifth mode of transport in the e-way bill system.
Adani Defence successfully test-fired four anti-tank missiles at the Pokhran Test Range.
Nifty reclaimed the 25,500 mark during last session recoveries while Nifty Smallcap 100 underperformed.
Markets bounced back strongly in recent sessions led by gains in banking and auto stocks.
summary:
In the last trading week, Indian benchmark indices Sensex and Nifty extended their rally to four consecutive weeks, reaching nine-month highs.
Record FII inflows alongside broad-based support from banking, auto, and IT sectors fueled the market momentum.
Investors absorbed global headwinds including AI stock selloffs and hawkish Fed signals to reclaim key technical levels.
